items.title: Vikings Valhalla: Diversity goes off track
items.description: The Netflix series, Vikings: Valhalla, features a black actress as an 11th Century noblewoman in Northern Europe. This is part of a trend of Hollywood overlooking historical context in the name of diversity, and refusing to pick its battles.
